fixture_name: M5 Junction 10 Improvements — UK Stage 1 (real scheme, OGL)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Refuge width/depth adequacy for cyclists and pushchair users near a high-demand bus stop is a substantive, well-recognised Stage 1 geometric safety issue on wide A4019 arms.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-UK-015 quote directly supports the pivotal claim that insufficiently wide refuges expose cyclists to vehicle clipping, with Table 4-1 cited as assumption basis.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern within GG 119 Stage 1 scope with no conflation into compliance matters; geometry remains adjustable at this stage.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names the provision (refuge depth/width), users (pushchair plus cycle), and locations (each A4019 crossing adjacent the bus stop), all viable pre-detailed design.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are explicitly identified as affected road users and both are addressed in the recommendation, fully covering VRU impact.

justifications.substance: Confirming that existing large-vehicle swept-path envelopes (already showing limited over-run into opposing lanes) remain valid after signal stop-line repositioning is a substantive, scheme-specific Stage 1 geometric-safety verification.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim that swept-path analysis covered the 7.5t box van and refuse vehicle is supported by the verbatim EV-UK-002 quote, while the stop-line repositioning trigger is presented as a recorded input fact in the scenario; no invented content detected.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly typed as a compliance_question kept categorically distinct from a safety problem, with the GG 119 analog noted and no safety defect asserted inside the question.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, actionable, and viable: re-run large-vehicle swept-path analysis over the as-adjusted stop-line positions before Stage 2, naming the exact analysis and timing.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians, cyclists, central refuges, and desire lines are explicitly acknowledged with recorded context, but VRU impacts are deliberately scoped out of this question rather than considered, so the acknowledgment-only cap of 1 applies.
